description: Start a new conversation in the room you are in. Give a topic if you have one; otherwise it is derived from what gets said. You are placed in it; others can join.

room.description: Room key, e.g. 'lobby' or 'main-bar' (or an instance key like 'main-bar#2' from enter_room).

topic.description: What it's about; derived from what gets said if omitted.

name: start_conversation
